about.title: About the archive
about.body1: The VIERNULVIER archive contains a rich collection of performances, concerts and events that took place in our arts center. From legendary performances in the 90s to contemporary dance and theatre.
about.body2: Use the search function to find specific artists, locations or periods. Discover stories behind the performances and relive special moments from the history of VIERNULVIER.

productions.description: Use this file to create productions. Contains fields for ID, NL/EN titles and descriptions, optional artist and tagline fields, credits and metadata.

events.description: Use this file to add events. Contains start/end times, optional doors/intermission times, location fields and a reference to productions via legacy ID.

tags.description: Use this file to create tags and attach them to productions. Contains Dutch and English tag names and a comma-separated list of production IDs.

blogs.description: Use this file for blogs (stories). Contains NL/EN titles and descriptions and a link to a production via legacy ID.

prices.description: Use this file for price information. Contains NL/EN price name, numeric price and a link to an event via legacy ID.

general.autoFill: If either language field is filled in, the other will be filled automatically.
general.disclaimer: Always use the IDs from previous CSV files to link to new objects.
general.uniqueIds: Ensure IDs are unique for events and productions.
